en.text: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.

footnotes.text: 138:1 The word elohim, used here, usually means “God” but can also mean “gods”, “princes”, or “angels”.

en.text: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.

zhSimplified.text: 我呼求的日子，你就应允我，

zhTraditional.text: 我呼求的日子，你就應允我，

en.text: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, LORD, for they have heard the words of your mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华啊，地上的君王都要称谢你，

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華啊，地上的君王都要稱謝你，

en.text: Yes, they will sing of the ways of the LORD, for the LORD’s glory is great!

zhSimplified.text: 他们要歌颂耶和华的作为，

zhTraditional.text: 他們要歌頌耶和華的作為，

en.text: For though the LORD is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but he knows the proud from afar.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华虽高，仍看顾低微的人；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華雖高，仍看顧低微的人；

en.text: Though I walk in the middle of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.

zhSimplified.text: 我虽行在患难中，你必将我救活；

zhTraditional.text: 我雖行在患難中，你必將我救活；

en.text: The LORD will fulfill that which concerns me. Your loving kindness, LORD, endures forever. forsake the works of your own hands.

zhSimplified.text: 耶和华必成全关乎我的事；

zhTraditional.text: 耶和華必成全關乎我的事；
